## 3 · Lock in or miss out 🔒
Each mate fills in the Lock-in form (bottom row): Claude reads the passport MRZ, all 5 ICAO check digits + the 6-month rule are verified in code, the scans go to the agent's workspace. After 24h, whoever's in, is in.

parameters.text: =🛂 Visa ✓ 📝 Arrival card ✓ 🌴 Bali tax ✓ Three QR codes are in everyone's inbox. We walk straight past the visa line.

parameters.content:
## 5 · The paperwork 🛂
Single-use Airwallex card per person, capped at the visa + tax, passed to the agent as a DOMAIN-LOCKED secret. The agent gets its own inbox for the OTP and only touches the official .go.id sites. Arrival card waits until it opens, 3 days out.
